about_the_game:
Adversity Reborn "is an easy to learn post apocalyptic survival game，The game dynamically sets up battle scenarios, requiring survivors to quickly enhance their strength to face imminent full-scale conflicts. Beyond the classic survival gameplay, the game introduces new stress-reducing mechanisms and unique features such as "No Combat at Start" and "Dinosaur Hunting." It strives to provide a fairer competitive environment while remaining simple and accessible, allowing more survivors to immerse themselves and enjoy a low-barrier survival journey in adversity!

Peaceful Start, Cooperative Survival

You can only rely on primitive survival skills to stay alive, which undoubtedly enhances the immersive experience of survival. However, during the first three days of the battle, PvP is only allowed in specific areas, while most regions remain non-combat zones. This gives survivors ample time to build their homes and stockpile resources. It also means that even if you lack "post-apocalyptic survival experience," you can still peacefully develop and team up with other survivors.

Dinosaur Hunting: Fun and Excitement

The interaction between dinosaurs and humans within the same ecosystem is a key source of fun in our game. As humans begin to dominate the ecosystem, they will inevitably tame dinosaurs for their own use. Dinosaurs will help you build your home, generate electricity, or serve as mounts to chase the wind and moon, or even dominate the battlefield amidst gunfire.

Team Development, Strategic Planning

The island environment is treacherous, requiring you to not only fend off hostile creatures but also face threats from other survivors. It is recommended that survivors form teams of four to deploy heavy machine guns, traps, and other defenses. Even if your home is damaged, there's no need to worry—you can repair it with a single click without having to rebuild from scratch. Of course, the best defense is often a good offense. Choose to actively attack other survivors' homes, using advanced weapons like C4, TNT, or rocket launchers to besiege and destroy other teams' shelters, plunder their safe resources and medals, and ultimately secure victory in escaping the mysterious island.

Repel Zombie Hordes, Explore Strongholds

The island features 16 large map gameplay modes and is home to 59 types of hostile creatures. The threats from AI mechanical beings and mutated creatures are everywhere, and from time to time, zombie hordes will attack your structures. By heading to the strongholds on the map, you can discover the hiding places of their bosses. However, this may require you to undergo a series of challenges such as exploration, puzzle-solving, and parkour. In addition to the bosses hidden in the strongholds, you must also be wary of the world bosses lurking in the wild mountains. The AI mechanical beings and mutated creatures in zombie hordes, strongholds, and world bosses all possess extremely powerful combat abilities, so it's recommended that you team up before venturing out!

Transform into a Boss, Wreak Havoc

The island boasts six types of terrain features and ten weather effects. However, the environment on the experimental island is becoming increasingly harsh. Some airdropped supplies from a mysterious scientific organization contain toxins, and if you accidentally come into contact with them, you will "transform into a boss" and become hostile to other survivors. Nevertheless, you will still receive generous resource rewards.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-3770 / AMD FX-9590 or better
  • Memory: 10 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050 / AMD 500 Series or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 MB available space

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-4790K / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or better
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 3060 / RX 570 Series or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 MB available space

short_description: Adversity Reborn is an easy-to-learn post-apocalyptic survival game where you'll scavenge resources on a desolate island to build your base, upgrade weapons to capture strategic strongholds, and team up with friends to construct defenses. Download now to experience the ultimate survival challenge!
